description: Antennes de toutes natures - Orléans Métropole is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data Orléans Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ANFR. Antennes de toutes natures installées sur le territoire d'Orléans Métropole. Source ANFR Le champ type réseau ajouté ici prend les valeurs suivantes: 'téléphonie mobile' sir le champ generation a comme valeur 2G/3G/4G/5G, 'autres réseaux ' sinon. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The portal files it under Aménagement numérique. The portal shows 8,550 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-orleans-metropole-fr-portal.
